cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've tapped my bowl with a spoon too. Formal greetings. Yours said hello; crockery hasn't spoken since the Great Washing-Up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was testing it for cracks. It says it wants bread.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Vessels checked. Trade has reopened. Offer a roll, but keep the butter separate; mixed gifts caused the gravy embargo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for a seat at dinner.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give it a stool, not a place setting. Plates were how the saucers won territory.
